message.reasoning_content:
I will write the scene as a single JSON plan object in structured screenplay-beat form.

The scene is set in the Fatelands, First Favored, during rituals and the First Sacrifice. It is scene 8 of 20. The player tightens the grip on the blade and steadies her breath. Julian denies involvement but unconvincingly. This move advances the A-plot toward suspicion of Julian. The PC↔LI relationship shifts. The entire scene must occur in one physical location.

The scene will run in three to four phases. It opens with Lirael observing from a distance, separated from Julian. The event is Julian tightening his fingers around her wrist as the murmur lands. Afterward, Lirael links Julian to the wish's independent path. She faces an unresolved choice: probe his sudden tension or let the words pass unremarked.

The scene continues from the prior ending, with the player standing between the path and Julian. The ritual clearing at dusk is the chosen location, featuring crimson spiralgrass and lengthening shadows. The camera will use a wide establishing or over-shoulder PC shot.

The scene will use adversarial or professional social staging. Attraction presence stays latent. Visual gravity will adapt the issue 1 trembling hands motif to the clearing, using the Dohkar's robes as the only color. The JSON plan is now being constructed.

The cast is closed to just the protagonist and Julian. The Dohkar will appear only as a distant presence behind them. The scene will open with the blade grip and Julian’s hand on her wrist, then his denial, then suspicion. The ending will be a soft proximity-to-hard-reversal cliff, driven by the Dohkar’s fire as an unseen countdown.
